create.title: Exact D=1 root-defect linearization and logarithmic collar
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), 1<<M<=R^2, J=M^(3/4), and Q_U=sum_(n>0 odd, |k(n)^2-Nn|>J)chi_4(n)n^(-3/4)A_U(n)e(sqrt(Nn)), with k(n)=floor(sqrt(Nn)+1/2), the literal zero-extended profile, endpoints, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam. Put j=k^2-Nn. There is no tie, and Q_U is in exact bijection with k>=1, -k<=j<=k-1, N|(k^2-j), positive odd quotient n=(k^2-j)/N in literal support. On support k asymp sqrt(NM), the total k-span and each cell are shorter than N, and the map has multiplicity one. Uniformly on the selected graph, -j/(k+sqrt(k^2-j))=-j/(2k)-j^2/[2k(k+sqrt(k^2-j))^2], so replacing the phase by e(-j/(2k)) costs O_epsilon(N^(-1/2)M^(-1/4)X^epsilon). For every fixed A>0, the complete collar J<|j|<=J(log(2X))^A has contribution O_(epsilon,A)(X^epsilon), by the all-parity root bound rho_N(j)<=4*2^omega(N)sqrt((|j|,N)) and its summed form. Hence Q_U equals the same literal signed wave restricted to |j|>J(log(2X))^A plus O_(epsilon,A)(X^epsilon). This is a logarithmic defect owner only: it gives no fixed positive-power enlargement, no new M-range, and no downstream theorem or exponent.
create.next_action: Attack the remaining |j|>M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A signed wave below M^449 asymp R^780 through a normalized outer-defect theorem for the linearized phase e(-j/(2k)) or the exact completed theta-Kloosterman family; keep A fixed and do not call the collar a positive-power range.

create.title: DFI theta-Kloosterman completion for the D=1 root-defect wave
create.statement_tex: Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec, Weyl Sums for Quadratic Roots, Section 6 and Lemma 6.1, define K(m,n;c)=sum_(a mod c)^* epsilon_a(c/a)e_c(m abar+n a) for c=0 mod 4 and prove |K(m,n;c)|<=(m,n,c)^(1/2)c^(1/2)tau(c), for arbitrary composite c and integer m,n; the official erratum does not alter this lemma. In the literal ambient root-defect completion, q=4N, d=(h,N) is odd, q'=q/d is 0 mod 4, b=2dv is the exact nonzero Gauss condition, and the complete unit-a sum is (1+i)chi_4(d)K(-v^2,-j;q'). Retaining the exterior d sqrt(q'), selector 1/(2N), finite Fourier 1/q, every d and v including v=0, BV profile, cell endpoints, both signs, and outer j gives |Q_U(V)|<<_epsilon(M^(-3/4)V+M^(-1/4))X^epsilon. This independently owns every fixed or polylogarithmic first defect collar but gives no positive-power or all-scale range. Mullner Theorem 5.3 and Lemma 5.4 audit the weaker termwise incomplete-Gauss route. Current modular-root, sparse-root, square-modulus, fixed-polynomial, and modulus-average theorems checked through 2026-08-25 do not directly match the remaining nonseparable outer-j coefficient; this is a direct no-match, not literature impossibility.
create.next_action: Use DFI Lemma 6.1 only with the exact d sqrt(q') prefactor, finite-Fourier and selector normalizations, zero mode, and all outer sums. A further gain requires a new theorem for the coupled signed outer-j, v, and d family, not another termwise Weil bound.

create.title: Selected-row collapse, ambient theta completion, and reciprocal self-return
create.statement_tex: For the literal D=d=L=1 direct large-defect root wave, the exact quotient selector is 1_(N|t)chi_4(t/N)=(-i/(2N))sum_(h mod 4N,h odd)chi_4(h)e(ht/(4N)). After t=Nn with n odd is already imposed, the unnormalized h rows are iQ_U or -iQ_U, so normalized h-Cauchy is equality and every ordered pair survives with its original character product. This is only a post-selection statement: the lawful ambient rows remain distinct. Exact finite k-completion has normalized form -i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_j sum_(d|N,d odd)chi_4(d)d sqrt(q') sum_(v mod q'/2) Bhat_j(2dv)K(-v^2,-j;q'), where q=4N and q'=q/d. The source-audited DFI bound, including every nonzero and zero dual mode, yields |Q_U(V)|<<_epsilon(M^(-3/4)V+M^(-1/4))X^epsilon, target-sized only on fixed or polylogarithmic first collars and losing N^(1/2)M^(-1/4) at V asymp sqrt(NM). If the already safe exact and small defects are restored at scalar level before completion, the full nearest cells partition the positive integers and the centered negative row h=4N-a has saddle n*=4N/a^2, phase e(N/a), and symbol e(1/8)N^(-1/4)chi_4(a)A_U(4N/a^2), exactly the accepted reciprocal-row principal self-return with its Round-152 remainder and endpoint ledger. These facts rule out post-selection frequency Cauchy, termwise DFI, independent k/j Gauss savings, and the principal full-cell transform as new gains. They do not rule out a future signed mask-preserving outer-defect theorem. The first open coefficient is nonseparable in j and v, and for odd N the character is constant on each fixed-j root fibre.
create.next_action: Prove a normalized signed outer-defect estimate after the exact theta-Kloosterman completion, or an equivalent selected cross-fibre theorem for e(-j/(2k)), preserving every gcd stratum, zero mode, sign, profile, endpoint, and the |j|>J(log(2X))^A mask.
